18 MAY 2026
Q2 prospectus · packet 24A delivered

Royal Mail signed-for. A working copy of the 2026.1 prospectus, your private year-three report, and a printed photo from the Cardigan wardens. The packet is yours to keep; no return is needed.
02 MAY 2026
Anniversary letter from Maire

A short hand-written letter marking the ninth year of your stewardship. Maire mentions the saltmarsh photo enclosed and asks after the rosemary.
14 APR 2026
Field report · Bordan Mire blocking complete

The hag your Feb gift co-financed has been blocked and is logging its first hydrograph above the surface line. A short field PDF is attached to your secure inbox.
06 MAR 2026
Tax receipts · UK + Republic of Ireland

Issued in two formats, one for HMRC and one for Revenue Online. The match contribution receipt is mailed separately from Halberd & Vine.
02 FEB 2026
Bequest draft v.3 returned for signature

Treasurer's office. The draft adds a contingent line for kelp loops and updates the spousal carve-out. Please sign in blue ink and return by post.
